_note: Bonus. The A2A AgentCard the kitchen-squad orchestrator WOULD advertise at /.well-known/agent-card.json if it were served. It is not served: orchestrator.py runs in-process. Skills are limited to what the squad demonstrably does on the six ferment cards; nothing here is aspirational.
name: Kitchen squad - South Indian ferments
description: Answers cooking questions about six South Indian ferment recipes by delegating to a substitution worker and an allergen/nutrition worker, then synthesising. Answers only from recorded recipe data, the substitution table and the ingredient database; says so when a check could not be done.

bearer.description: Scoped token. scope recipes:read covers search and substitution; scope ingredients:nutrition covers per-100g nutrition.

skills.name: Recorded ingredient substitution
skills.description: Finds a recipe and a recorded substitute for one ingredient under one dietary constraint (dairy, coconut, nuts, gluten, alcohol, yeast, soy), including what the substitute itself contains. Refuses to invent unrecorded swaps.
examples: no curd for moru, what else can i use
i have no toddy for sanna, what can i use instead

skills.name: Allergen and nutrition check
skills.description: Checks a recipe or ingredient against the allergen flags and per-100g nutrition in the ingredient database, and checks a proposed substitute before it is recommended. Needs the user's allergy list; asks for it when it is missing.
examples: is moru ok if im allergic to milk
how much protein is in 100g of urad dal
